description: Creates or updates one collection in Development from its declaration — exactly the JSON of gemmein/collections/<name>.json ({ rule, fields, unlockedBy, publishing, openFields, directInitiation, rankable }). Same validator as gemmein dev and sync: a bad name, rule or field is refused with the fix. Don't store health or medical data, biometric data, government ID numbers (such as social security or passport numbers) or payment card details in a collection; payments go through Stripe, which holds card details. A field whose name says it holds one of those (ssn, passport_number, card_number, cvc, diagnosis, medical_record…) is refused (sensitive_field). A rule never changes on an existing collection (that is a delete and recreate, which the founder approves). explain_rule explains each rule. A collection is what a founder may call a list of things the app keeps; its rule, who can see it.
name: declare_collection
title: Declare a collection
